decisions.reason: The water phantom for particle therapy builds on the firm's existing dosimetry QA knowledge and is scheduled for release in Q1 2019, so the firm is likely to keep it while learning from initial placements.
This small-volume ionization chamber directly leverages the firm's decades of dosimetry and calibration knowledge, enabling it to interpret early results and improve the product.
As a small-volume chamber, it fits the firm's core measurement expertise, so the firm can assimilate feedback and keep it.
The standard clinical ionization chamber line aligns closely with existing clinical dosimetry products, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to maintain and refine it.
Relative dosimetry chambers are within the firm's established measurement and calibration capabilities, so the probability of dropping is low.
